- **G? [M] Your data: back up everything into one versioned zip** (2026-11-20) · Return, Honour · aligned
  From: /investigate, the owner's ask (2026-11-20). Brief: docs/research/app-backup.md.
  Calls: restore adds what is missing by id, never overwrites; a small "Your data" page from Walk settings (amends 0041); a plain zip, versioned so older backups always restore; a quiet "Last backed up" line, no reminder. Decision 0241.
  Done when: on the web build at 390 px, from Walk settings, "Your data" then "Back up everything" gives one zip holding every walk, moment and file, and the page then says when; after the restore slice, that zip restored into an empty browser shows the same walks, moments and replays.
  Area: export, storage, walk-screen. The first slice of an L; the second is Restore from a backup (brief, "The recommendation").
  Touches: VISION.md Never, "Data leaving the device without a tap" (fit: "The share sheet on a tap") and "Nagging"; Always, "Moments and the trace are truth; streets, areas and summaries are recomputed" and "Counts are words"; decisions 0005, 0007 and 0041 (amended by 0241), 0107.
  The slice: 1. Walk settings ends with a "Your data" row opening a "Your data" page; Back returns to the drawer as it was. 2. "Back up everything" writes one zip: manifest.json (format chronicles-backup, format version, app and schema versions, when, the stores held), one JSON per truth store (the trace per walk), the preferences and per-walk meta, every piece's original under media/ at its ref. 3. No cache in the file; a test classifies every store and meta key as backed up or cache and fails on one it does not know. 4. A pure core reads every older format version through a chain of upgrade steps into today's rows and refuses a newer one in words; a frozen sample file per released format version must read. 5. A seeded library (every truth store, a loose moment, an edited photo, a thread, a reaction) backed up and read by the core gives back the same rows, ids and trace order. 6. Media streamed in chunks; native writes under the cache, opens the share sheet and deletes after; the web downloads; a missing file is left out, marked and said in words. 7. On native the room left is read first; too little, it says so and writes nothing. 8. Under the button "Last backed up October 3" or "Not backed up yet"; nothing else ever reminds or notifies. 9. One line says what the file is and that anyone with it can see the walks and photos; no size, count, percentage or gauge; nothing celebrates; the app sends the file nowhere by itself. 10. An e2e journey `backup` on the web: the download's manifest and rows match the seeded walk and the line reads today; native share and file handle in NATIVE_UNVERIFIED.
  Precedent: Apple Journal, "Export All Journal Entries", one ZIP with media, no import (verified); Day One, "Export Day One JSON" and "Import JSON" (verified); Organic Maps, one KMZ it reads back (unverified). docs/research/adjacent-apps.md, "Back up everything and restore it". Departs from Apple Journal and Polarsteps: the file is made to be read back.
  Payoff: every moment gets a copy the owner holds, before anything is lost with a phone or a cleared browser. Cost: M; about eight source files (a route, lib/backup core, shell and two adapters, StartSettings, meta); native share and file handle unverified; no new dependency. Reopens: export, walk-screen. After it: Restore from a backup (M).
  Instead: criteria 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 (the page and the backup, versioning held by the round trip alone).
